# Inspection and sanitising fixtures

`torture.docx`, `torture.xlsx` and `torture.pptx` are generated by `tests/OneDocument.Cli.Tests/TortureFiles.cs`: one document per kind with every category of hidden data and personal information present. Every personal string starts with `PLANTED-`. Regenerate them with

    ONEDOCUMENT_TORTURE_OUT=testdata/inspect  <the Cli.Tests executable> -method RecursiveAI.OneDocument.Cli.Tests.InspectionTests.The_generated_documents_can_be_written_for_other_tools

The output is deterministic. `sanitized/default.*` and `sanitized/all.*` are what `onedocument sanitize <in> <out>` and `onedocument sanitize <in> <out> --all` write from them (the tool built from the same commit). Both validate against the ECMA-376 Transitional schemas and convert to PDF in LibreOffice 26.8.2.2 (black box).

The torture files are test inputs, not documents Office wrote; Office is expected to open them but a repair prompt on them is not a finding about the sanitiser.
